rationale: T9 analysis of denial hotspots by place of service, auth requirement, and network status. Denial codes ranked among denied_claims only per T4 feedback (all_claims mixes in non-denied claims without codes). Denial rates use adjudicated_claims denominator per T2 guidance (excludes pending). Min_group_size=30 flags unstable small segments. Report includes small_groups caveat per T4 feedback.
